SMTO-CFG-0020 — SMTO got new-chat choices without the rest of the chat's settings

GUID: 521b348a-569a-4929-9621-97b31dfe9a1e
Slug: composer-profile-required
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • Starting a new conversation needs both its scheduling choices, like Parallel execution, and its message-box settings, like mode and Gateway. Only the first part arrived, so SMTO didn't start the conversation or the task.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the page, select New chat, and check the mode, Target and Options above the message box before sending. Reloading rebuilds the full set of settings, so both parts are sent together.
  2. If you started this from a tool, script or shortcut outside the SMTO page, ask its owner to include the message-box settings or leave out the new-chat choices. The SMTO page always sends both parts, but other senders must do the same.

What success looks like

  • Your new conversation appears in the Conversations pane and its first task starts.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep resending from the same tool or shortcut until it is fixed; each attempt will be refused.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Task admission rejected the submission because conversation_policy_defaults were supplied without composer_values, which are required to bind a new conversation's selections.

What this means

  • Submission supplies pending conversation policy defaults without composer values needed to bind the new conversation's selections. Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.

Why this can happen

  • Submission supplies pending conversation policy defaults without composer values needed to bind the new conversation's selections.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the pending-defaults and composer_values fields as one new-conversation submission.

How to fix it

  • Send a complete composer_values object whenever conversation_policy_defaults is present, or omit conversation_policy_defaults. The desktop client builds both from SMTOComposerProfile.submission().
  • Supply the composer profile together with pending conversation policies.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Pending defaults arrive with a complete supported composer profile.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
